description: Most of the diagram came back as loose captions instead of boxes; only 2 of the 6 things drawn became boxes.
ascii:
+---------------------------------------------+
|             web.py module scope             |
|                                             |
| JOBS: dict[str, Job] = {}  <- lives forever |
+---------------------------------------------+
                      |
                      | _launch(card_id)
                      v
               +-------------+
               | Job         |
               | .events     |  <- grows while
               | .subscribers|     turn runs
               | .finished   |
               +------+------+
                      |
             _drive() | streams events,
                      | calls job.emit()
                      v
             finally: job.finished = True
                      |
                      X   no JOBS.pop(card_id)
                      |   anywhere in web.py
                      v
             entry + its .events list
             stay in JOBS forever

card.title: Job lifecycle in JOBS dict
card.remark: The Job buffer replays every event to late subscribers. Is that the decision I would have taken, or does it leak memory on long trails?
